claims.statement: Baker Hughes and Kodiak (joint release, 2026-07-08): multi-year agreement; the initial award is about 1 GW of NovaLT16 and Frame 5 gas turbines plus BRUSH generators, delivered by 2030 for behind-the-meter power serving data center and energy infrastructure demand, with a framework up to 1.8 GW. Joint supplier–customer announcement; the data-center share of the 1 GW is not stated.

source_doc.title: Kodiak Gas Services 與 Baker Hughes 聯合新聞稿（2026-07-08，Baker Hughes IR）：多年期燃機訂單框架，首批約 1 GW 燃機與發電機（NovaLT16、Frame 5、BRUSH 發電機）2030 年前交，做表後供電；框架上看 1.8 GW

sources.quote: Initial major award includes approximately 1 GW of gas turbines and generators delivered by 2030 to support scalable, behind-the-meter power solutions

Kodiak Gas Services, Inc. (NYSE: KGS) (“Kodiak”), a leading provider of critical energy infrastructure, and Baker Hughes (NASDAQ: BKR), an energy technology company, announced Wednesday a multi-year strategic agreement under which Baker Hughes will provide power generation solutions to support Kodiak’s expanding energy infrastructure initiatives.

The initial major order includes NovaLT™16 gas turbines, Frame 5 gas turbines and BRUSH™ Power Generation generators, providing core technologies to deliver dependable power for growing data center and energy infrastructure demand.
